text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер gains more confidence after
her
performance in the autumn Tenno
Sho. She
aspires to compete in the Arima
Kinen next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Найс Нэйчер happens
upon Tokai
Teio in the shopping district.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Teio recognizes Найс Нэйчер as a
powerful
opponent, yet taunts her by
saying that she
cannot win unless she
goes all out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the people in the shopping district
urging
her on after Teio's taunts, Nice
Nature
confidently declares that she'll
win the Chunichi
Shimbun Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
